body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Until your next turn, detect moving creatures within 3 units through ordinary concealment and gain +1 Composure against sensory effects.

surges.html: Mark one detected enemy; ordinary concealment cannot hide its occupied space from you until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Strain - Trance
rider.html: Enter Inner Room Trance until the end of your next turn: the first Psionics card you use against a marked enemy may ignore 1 point of cover bonus; using this benefit ends the Trance.
